reviews.heading: What Customers Say About Our Long Distance Moves

faq.q: How do long distance movers in Raleigh price a move?
faq.a: We quote long distance moves at a flat rate. The quote is built from your move date, the size of your home and both addresses.

faq.q: Do you handle Raleigh to Boston moves?
faq.a: Yes. Boston is our home market, so a Raleigh to Boston move has our crews loading in Raleigh and unloading in Boston.

faq.q: Do you move families into Raleigh from other states?
faq.a: Yes. Moves into the Triangle get the same flat-rate pricing, carried by our own truck.

faq.q: Can my things be stored before delivery to my new state?
faq.a: Yes. We store them between pickup and delivery. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faq.q: Can the crew pack my Raleigh home before a long distance move?
faq.a: Yes. Full or partial packing goes on the same quote, and boxes are packed for the length of the drive.
